After committing, create two files:

commit any changes. The PR_COMMENTS.md can be empty in this case.

you created for yourself and completed. If you performed validation, background research, etc, be sure to mention this.

"changes committed in PR #<NN>" (note: use the literal `<NN>` in the output, I will replace it with the actual PR number).

If the issue is a complex one, you can create a high level summary of the decisions you made. If things are not clear
or if you want particular people in the thread to check particular aspects you can mention them.

Follow any CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md or other relevant files in the repository.

  "body": "Please check that the term does not already exist by using the ontology search tool OLS:\nhttps://www.ebi.ac.uk/ols4/ontologies/cl\n\n\n**Preferred term label**\ntransitional principal-intercalated cell of kidney collecting duct\n\n**Synonyms** (add reference(s), please)\ntPC-IC cell - related synonym - abbreviation - PMID: 37468583\nhybrid principal-intercalated cell - broad synonym - PMID: [33893305](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/33893305/)\n\n**Definition** (free text, with reference(s), please. PubMed ID format is PMID: XXXXXX)\nA transitional cell located in the renal collecting duct that co-expresses markers of both principal cell (PC) and intercalated cell (IC). This hybrid cell is enriched in Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD).\n\nPMID: 37468583\nPMID: [33893305](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/33893305/)\n\n**Parent cell type term** (check the hierarchy here https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ols4/ontologies/cl)\n[CL_1000454](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_1000454) kidney collecting duct epithelial cell \n\n**Anatomical structure where the cell type is found** (check Uberon for anatomical structures: https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ols4/ontologies/uberon)\n[UBERON_0001232](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/UBERON_0001232) collecting duct of renal tubule\n\n\n**Your ORCID**\nhttps://orcid.org/0000-0002-2999-0103\nhttps://orcid.org/0009-0000-8480-9277\n\n**Additional notes or concerns**\nThe term is needed to annotate HuBMap data. The definition provided by Dr. Sanjay Jain\n\n",

## Summary

Added a new CL term for issue #3259:

- `CL_9900001` transitional principal-intercalated cell of kidney collecting duct

## Changes made

- Added class declaration and term axioms in `src/ontology/cl-edit.owl`.
- Added a textual definition citing PMID:33893305 and PMID:37468583.
- Placed the term under `CL_1000454` kidney collecting duct epithelial cell.
- Added a `part_of` relationship to `UBERON_0001232` collecting duct of renal tubule.
- Added requested synonyms:
  - `tPC-IC cell` as a related abbreviation synonym, PMID:37468583
  - `hybrid principal-intercalated cell` as a broad synonym, PMID:33893305
  - `transitional principal-intercalated cell` as an exact synonym, PMID:37468583
- Added contributor ORCIDs from the issue.
- Added `terms:date`, `dc:creator`, and issue tracker metadata.
- Added a comment noting reported enrichment in chronic kidney disease.

## Rationale and checks

- Confirmed no existing CL term for `transitional principal-intercalated`, `principal-intercalated`, `tPC-IC`, or `hybrid principal-intercalated` was present in `src/ontology/cl-edit.owl`.
- Checked the requested parent `CL_1000454` and related collecting duct principal/intercalated cell terms for consistency.
- Used a new `CL_99xxxxx` identifier per the NTR ID range guidance.
- Validated OWL functional syntax with:
  - `robot convert --input src/ontology/cl-edit.owl --output /tmp/cl-edit-test.owl`

Signed-off-by: GitHub Copilot
